title: Private Emerald Bay Boat Cruise 2 Hours Lake Tahoe Up To 12 Guest
includes: Captain Fee - $60/hour due upon arrival ($100/hour Holiday rate applies) (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our classic 2 hour shoreline cruise offers guests a unique and private experience! Tour the sights of beautiful South Lake Tahoe. Feel free to bring any food or beverages to make your trip more enjoyable! Turn up the music, enjoy a beverage, and have fun with BayWatch Boat Charters! Feel free to add additional hours once you contact us if available. 

Your charter includes a captain and can accommodate up to 12 guests. 
All bookings must be accompanied by our Baywatch approved captains and a $60 per hour captain fee is collected at the beginning of the trip. (HOLIDAY RATE MAY APPLY)

Enjoy an unprecedented luxury lake cruise or an all day excursion and get a local crew that will offer an amazing experience!
